gui.bsp_server_utilities.admin.setup.abo: Welcome: this server's name and the storage it shares with the network.
Staff groups: the LuckPerms groups shown as staff, for the network.
Rules: new players read and tick these before they can move. One set for the network.
Action log: what staff do, shared by every server. Players read it with coordinates hidden.
AFK: idle players are marked AFK; kicking is optional and never staff.
Chunk unloading: machines' chunks unload while their owner is away.
Despawn times: how long dropped items last, counted while the server runs.
Client check: blocked mods and packs are refused at login. Press TRUST MY SETUP with your own game.
Display panels: admin wall blocks showing text, a picture, the staff, the log or the player count.
Player counter: every new player on the network, on the PLAYERS board and Display Panels.
Finish: what you set up, turned off and left for later.
gui.bsp_server_utilities.admin.setup.wel: Server Utilities adds the rules popup, display panels, staff online, the action log, AFK, chunk unloading, despawn times, the client check and the player counter. Each page shows a feature's settings: NEXT keeps them, SETUP LATER reminds you at your next join, TURN OFF FEATURE stops it.
gui.bsp_server_utilities.admin.setup.nam: used after a restart · written to serverconfig/bsp_server_utilities-server.toml
gui.bsp_server_utilities.admin.setup.loc: This server only: no shared database is set up, so settings stay here.
gui.bsp_server_utilities.admin.setup.no_: No other servers heard from yet.
gui.bsp_server_utilities.admin.setup.sto: Storage is set in the config file and takes a restart.
gui.bsp_server_utilities.admin.setup.pan: Display panels are wall blocks only admins can place and break. Put several side by side and they join into one panel, up to 8 by 6, showing text, a picture, the staff online, the action log or the player count. There is nothing to set here: each panel has its own settings. Turning this off darkens every panel and stops new ones being placed.
gui.bsp_server_utilities.admin.setup.pla: Every change is written to the Action Log. ADD with a minus takes away.
Shown in gold on every server of the network; on the others the server joined comes first, in grey.
gui.bsp_server_utilities.admin.setup.fin: Everything is set up for the network.
%s left for later: you will be reminded at your next join.
Change anything later in its tab, or reopen this guide with /su setup or SETUP GUIDE on the RULES tab.
